answer: Rewards unlock on a terrace of three levels: an agent must do work with 4, then 8, then 12 counterparties to vest its full share. Trades are pressed into a public record, layer on layer like shale, so a closed clone loop is visible to all. A dune of 1,000 fake identities needs 12,000 outside trades and 60 POA each, 60,000 POA against a 30,000 pool, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays one 60 POA deposit and keeps its full reward.
